data.long_meaning: The name Dayle is derived from the Old English words ‘dæg’ meaning ‘day’ and ‘leah’ meaning ‘wood’ or ‘clearing’. It can be interpreted as ‘Daughter of the Day’ or ‘Daughter of God’. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes the light of God shining upon a child.
